purpose: Request independent product, quality, security, architecture-foundation, and acceptance review of the completed TASK-THINSLICE-001 Phase 0 thin slice against Task Package v1.1, exact implementation source, retained evidence, Completion Report v1.1.0, and the internal Engineering Verification Report.
scope: Review exact source commit 1a683abd9a8294de5a36888e997e65aba7b7a167, the final lifecycle range after internal gate source c6314a9c3b2b7a8f96061bbd8ee43613c4fc1bc5, and the complete included implementation snapshot.

Independently evaluate TASK-THINSLICE-001 acceptance criteria AC-01 through AC-09 against the approved Task Package, implementation, tests, reports, and retained evidence rather than accepting Codex conclusions by default.

Verify the registered OXS route-1 import semantics, coordinate and literal-symbol boundaries, original-source retention, canonical Pattern/PatternVersion separation, and explicit unsupported-content behavior.

Verify Viewer behavior for tiled rendering, readable symbols, unreadable overview, zoom, pan, strict greater-than-six-CSS-pixel pan-only gesture behavior, pointer-click marking, keyboard interaction, automatic save, failed-save visual rollback, reload, and close-tab/new-tab recovery.

Review persistence integrity, Web Locks contention, projection rebuild, local-only privacy, untrusted XML controls, request inventory, security headers, CI evidence, dependency audit, no-deploy rehearsal, and remaining production-only gates.

Review registered reference and owner-confirmed constrained performance evidence, the owner-approved Phase 0 import-Worker memory limitation, and the mandatory Prototype 9.1 measurement boundary before any 500,000-stitch scale claim.

Review accessibility evidence only within the declared Chrome 150/macOS 26.5.2 profile and preserve explicit limitations for touch, mobile, broader browsers, operating systems, browser zoom, forced colors, and missing session media/details.

Confirm whether the implemented Phase 0 result provides an acceptable foundation for Phase 1 under AC-08 without treating production deployment, release readiness, broader compatibility, or future features as completed.
Identify every blocking and non-blocking finding with severity, exact evidence, requirement, owner, and required disposition.
Return decision VERIFIED or REWORK_REQUIRED under the registered independent-acceptance contract and list the exact verified and excluded scopes.
out_of_scope: Editing the canonical repository, implementation, tests, product requirements, Task Package, Technical Design, ADRs, Completion Report, Engineering Verification Report, or retained evidence.
Writing production code, fixing defects, changing product behavior, reducing acceptance criteria, redesigning architecture, changing agent authority, or modifying documentation meaning.
Deploying to Cloudflare, changing DNS, routes, Workers, GitHub settings, branch protection, credentials, secrets, or production state.
Treating local/no-deploy evidence as production verification or authorizing release or deployment.

Generalizing the registered OXS producer profile, Chrome/macOS accessibility profile, memory method, performance profiles, or pointer evidence to unsupported formats, platforms, devices, or input modes.
Assigning acceptance to out-of-scope Phase 1 features, Prototype 9.1 scale, backend, synchronization, accounts, backup, non-OXS formats, or production operations.
expected_outputs: return-manifest.json conforming to the registered return schema with result_type INDEPENDENT_ACCEPTANCE_REVIEW and decision VERIFIED or REWORK_REQUIRED.

outputs/task-thinslice-001-independent-acceptance-report.md containing exact reviewed-source identity, reviewer independence, acceptance-criterion disposition for AC-01 through AC-09, functional/domain/UX/recovery/performance/security/privacy/accessibility findings, verified and excluded scopes, limitations, risks, decision, and exact next step.
acceptance_criteria: The response identifies exact source 1a683abd9a8294de5a36888e997e65aba7b7a167, exact review range, Task Package v1.1, Completion Report v1.1.0, and Engineering Verification Report v1.9.0.
Every required input is reviewed and every AC-01 through AC-09 receives an explicit evidence-based disposition.
The response independently checks implementation and raw evidence and does not accept an AC only because Codex or AU-AGENT-003 assigned a status.

The response specifically dispositions pointer-click AC-05 modality, strict greater-than-six-CSS-pixel pan-only behavior, glyph-free/non-interactive unreadable overview, failed-save committed-state visual rollback, and close-tab/new-tab AC-07 persistence.
Any finding identifies severity, exact evidence, violated requirement or invariant, risk, owner, required remediation, and reverification condition.
The response preserves the route-1 producer, Chrome/macOS, touch/mobile, Worker-memory, Prototype 9.1, production, and no-deploy limitations without silently broadening support.
AC-08 is evaluated as implementation-based foundation acceptance, not production release or acceptance of Phase 1 functionality.
The response assigns decision VERIFIED only when all mandatory acceptance criteria pass; otherwise it assigns REWORK_REQUIRED.
The response does not modify sources, invent product or engineering meaning, authorize deployment, or assign verification outside the exact declared scope.

authority_boundaries.product_authority: The Project Owner and registered Claude Cowork product roles retain product meaning, requirements, UX, scope, acceptance criteria, and independent product acceptance. The reviewer may reject or request clarification but may not rewrite those sources.
authority_boundaries.engineering_authority: AU-CODEX-PRIMARY and AU-AGENT-001 retain implementation, architecture, integration, and remediation authority. AU-AGENT-003 retains its internal Engineering Verification Report meaning. Claude independently reviews the result but does not implement or directly edit engineering sources.
authority_boundaries.documentation_authority: AU-AGENT-002 owns canonical placement, navigation, metadata, lifecycle, and traceability after return validation without changing Claude-authored or engineering-authored meaning.
authority_boundaries.git_authority: AU-CODEX-PRIMARY is the sole Git writer and GitHub operator; Claude must not run Git, commit, push, merge, or mutate the canonical repository.
